accounts: two separate10000USD modeled baseline/stress accounts, never pooled capital
intent: freeze integer quantities and limit prices from Oct23 closes before Oct26 open; retain canonical SHA256; no retrospective entries if intent created late
execution: indicative daily auction-open proxy only if below fixed limit; terminal market-on-close proxy; not actual orders or verified fill prices
data: public Yahoo raw unadjusted OHLCV/dividends; complete-calendar and raw-hash audit; reject splits, missing or partial sessions; no repairs
accounting: hold fixed initial shares through terminal close; exdate dividends from carried quantity,90day receivable cash delay; allfeesandhypotheticalclosingcosts in marks
reporting: daily netPnL, drawdown, cash, share inventory and receivables; no early success stopping, no retuning; a positive observed return alone is not confirmation
data_or_execution_failure: fail closed; report unreconciled/no marks rather than publish estimated profits
